```{ojs}
//| echo: false

generateTabulatorTableFromCSV(
  "#my-table",                          // CSS selector for the table container
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/annika-bergstrom/csv-data-/refs/heads/main/SPT%20Production%20History%20-%20Sheet1.csv",      // <-- plug in your CSV URL or file path here

  {
    displayedColumns: [                 // columns to show (in order)
      "Year",
      "Season",
      "Show",
      "Genre",
      "Times_Performed",
      "Run_Time",
    ],

    numericColumns: ["Year", "Times_Performed", "Run_Time"],       // columns to treat as numbers (enables range filters)

    categoryColumns: ["Season", "Genre"],      // columns to treat as categories (enables dropdown filters)

    sortColumns: ["Year"],          // default sort column(s)
    sortOrders: ["asc"]                 // "asc" or "desc" for each sort column
  }
);
```
